name: smwmusic-mega-man-flames-of-justice-fire-man-s-stage-remix
title: Mega Man - Flames Of Justice! ~ Fire Man's Stage (Remix)
description:
𝗘𝘃𝗶𝗹! 𝗥𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝗺𝘆 𝗻𝗮𝗺𝗲! 𝗙𝗼𝗿 𝗜 𝗮𝗺 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗮𝗻! 𝗠𝘆 𝗳𝗹𝗮𝗺𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗰𝗲 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝗶𝘁𝘀 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝘆𝗼𝘂!

Did an arrangement of Fire Man's Stage from Mega Man Numero Uno. It's my favorite song in Mega Man 1 just because it goes really freaking hard, and I had to do it!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. F# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F Minor (Powered-Up Pitch)
3. G Minor (Custom Pitch)
